caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your brain is an amazing illusionist, easily tricked into seeing entire virtual worlds!

Here's how this mind-bending trick works:
🔹 VR headsets show a slightly different image to each eye.
🔹 Your brain then masterfully combines these flat images to create a feeling of incredible depth and 3D.
🔹 AI steps in, tracking your movements and rendering new scenes so fast it feels completely real, transforming simple screens into vast digital landscapes!
